required_facts.description: icon.dat's content changed between base and head; Shiftory's evidence reports this only as an opaque binary unit identified by differing blob hashes, with no textual diff content available.

Because no textual or decoded representation of icon.dat's bytes is available in the evidence, what the new bytes actually depict or represent cannot be determined; any specific claim about the file's visual/semantic meaning is not supported by the available evidence.
The file mode is 100644 on both sides; only the file's content changed, not its permissions or type.
